notes: Nemea reds are made from Agiorgitiko, dry or sweet.
The best come from mid-slope vineyards, since the hilltops can be too acidic and the valley floor too jammy.

blurb.text: A Peloponnese PDO for red wine made only from Agiorgitiko. It also allows liqueur wine and wine from raisined grapes.
